title: Breadcrumb Generator
description: Build an accessible breadcrumb trail from your path segments — live preview plus HTML and CSS.
howto: Enter path segments (one per line, or a full /path).
Pick a separator and visual style.
Copy the code or download the self-contained breadcrumb.html.

faqs.q: What segment format do I use?
faqs.a: One per line ("Home", "Products", "Shoes") — or paste a full path like /products/shoes and it is split automatically.
Yes — it uses <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> with an ordered list, and the current page gets aria-current="page".

faqs.q: Can I use a custom separator?
faqs.a: Choose the custom option and type any character or symbol.

faqs.q: Can I embed it in my page?
faqs.a: Copy the markup and the <style> block. All classes are prefixed with bc- to avoid collisions.
